title: BellRing jumped 25% after beating on sales and raising the outlook. Isprotein-powder growth really worth a move that big?
author: tickeron_community
selftext:
\[BRBR\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/BRBR/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/BRBR/)) jumped 24.52% to $13.71 from  
the prior close of $11.01, gapping higher in premarket and extending  
the advance in Wednesday's regular session.  
  
The catalyst was premarket fiscal Q4 results: net sales of $692  
million beat the roughly $657 million consensus, and FY2027 adjusted  
EBITDA guidance of $310–$350 million topped the roughly $317 million  
estimate. The company also announced a $100 million three-year  
supply-chain savings program and a new CFO.  
  
The earnings write-up, including the beat, the guidance, and the  
savings program:  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-bellring-brands-brbr-stock-up-24-98-today-40389/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-bellring-brands-brbr-stock-up-24-98-today-40389/)  
  
Is a beat and a slightly better outlook enough to justify a 25% gap,  
or did the stock just get too cheap after a rough stretch?  
  
Not financial advice. Figures are from today's write-up, not a live quote.
